newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers softer, recovery due later.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers softer, recovery due later.

text.p: Singapore bunkers on Tuesday were quoted lower as sellers dropped offers in line with a correction made in published quotes, traders said.

A correction of around $3 downwards on a publication's Singapore bunker quotes due to a "typo error", propmted sellers to lower offers for 380-cst to $121-$122 per tonne, down from $121-$124 on Monday and 180-cst to $127-$129 from $127-$131.
But a major expected prices to recover in line with an anticipated rise in cargo levels later as any bearish sentiment caused by the return of Iraqi crude had already been factored in.
MDO quotes were far apart at $230-$250 and gas oil steady at $254-$257.
